# KaTeX 0.18.7

Pinned browser distribution from the official `katex` npm package. Only the minified UMD renderer, minified stylesheet, its referenced fonts and the MIT license are included. No auto-render extension is needed.

- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.18.7.tgz
- Official browser documentation: https://katex.org/docs/browser.html
- Official API documentation: https://katex.org/docs/api.html
- Verified: 2026-09-14
- npm archive integrity: `sha512-h+UCwkZ+4Jz8WQ7MLGfj7UVFrRCizGb912fwF4luGdYsC5paYG1vx+jy+KRcC/XkpjGva/P7nAWuxNnPzRvzHw==`

Keep `fonts/` beside `katex.min.css`; the stylesheet uses relative font URLs. Source files are unmodified.
